items.raw_excerpt: The Mar Me Quer festival returns to Portimão from 12 to 14 August, bringing three evenings of live music to the city's riverside.
items.summary_en: The Mar Me Quer festival returns to Portimao from 12 to 14 August. It brings three evenings of live music to the city's riverside.

items.raw_excerpt: The 2026 Dadaocheng Summer Festival will conclude Saturday evening with a 20-minute show featuring an eight-minute fireworks display and a Spider-Man-themed drone light show, the Taipei City Department of Information and Tourism said Wednesday.
items.summary_en: The 2026 Dadaocheng Summer Festival ends Saturday evening with a 20-minute show. The show includes an eight-minute fireworks display and a Spider-Man-themed drone light show. The Taipei City Department of Information and Tourism announced the plan on Wednesday.
items.summary_ko: 2026년 다다오청 여름 축제가 토요일 저녁 폐막 공연으로 마무리됩니다. 20분간 진행되는 공연에는 8분짜리 불꽃놀이와 스파이더맨 테마의 드론 라이트쇼가 포함됩니다. 타이베이시 정보관광국이 수요일에 이 계획을 발표했습니다.
items.title_en: Dadaocheng Summer Festival finale to feature fireworks and drone light show

items.raw_excerpt: The Vu Lan Festival will take place from Aug. 12 to 19 at Tay Thien Mandala in Dai Dinh Commune in Phu Tho Province, led by His Eminence Thuksey Rinpoche and a monastic delegation from the Drukpa Lineage in India.
items.summary_en: The Vu Lan Festival runs from August 12 to 19 at Tay Thien Mandala in Phu Tho Province, Vietnam. Buddhist monks from the Drukpa Lineage in India will lead the event. The festival honors parents and is held at a Vajrayana stupa.
items.summary_ko: 부란 축제가 8월 12일부터 19일까지 베트남 푸토성 다이딘 마을의 타이티엔 만달라에서 열립니다. 인도 드루크파 승단의 스님이 행사를 이끕니다. 부모님께 감사하는 뜻을 담아 사리탑에서 개최됩니다.
items.title_en: Vu Lan festival opens at Vajrayana stupa in Vietnam
items.title_ko: 부란 축제, 베트남 바지라야나 사리탑에서 열려
items.title_original: Vu Lan festival held at Vajrayana stupa in Vietnam

items.raw_excerpt: Taoyuan will expand its free milk program to include junior high school students beginning with the 2026 school year that commences on Aug. 31, the Taoyuan City government announced Wednesday.
items.summary_en: Taoyuan will give free milk to junior high school students starting in the 2026 school year. The new school year begins on Aug. 31. The city government made the announcement on Wednesday.
items.summary_ko: 타오위안시가 2026학년도부터 중학교 학생에게도 무상 우유를 지원한다고 밝혔습니다. 새 학기는 8월 31일에 시작합니다. 이번 수요일에 시가 이 계획을 발표했습니다.
items.title_en: Taoyuan to expand free milk program to junior high school students
items.title_ko: 타오위안시 중학생에도 무상 우유 지원 확대
items.title_original: Taoyuan to expand free milk program to junior high school students

items.raw_excerpt: Some preschools are monitoring air quality readings as often as every two hours, while others have prepared indoor activities and air purifiers as Singapore faces a heightened risk of severe haze in the second half of the year.
items.summary_en: Singapore may face heavy haze in the second half of the year. Preschools are watching air quality readings as often as every two hours. Some have prepared indoor activities and air purifiers.
items.summary_ko: 싱가포르는 올해 하반기에 심한 연무가 생길 수 있습니다. 어린이집들은 공기 질 수치를 두 시간마다 확인하고 있습니다. 어떤 곳은 실내 활동과 공기 청정기를 준비했습니다.
items.title_en: Haze risk: Singapore preschools ready to move activities indoors
items.title_ko: 연무 위험: 싱가포르 어린이집, 실내 활동 준비
items.title_original: Haze risk in Singapore: Preschools ready to move activities indoors if air quality worsens

items.raw_excerpt: Young people aged 12 to 29 will receive free admission to national museums and monuments managed by Museus e Monumentos de Portugal (MMP) this Wednesday to mark International Youth Day, the state-owned company announced.
items.summary_en: Young people aged 12 to 29 can visit national museums and monuments in Portugal for free this Wednesday. The free entry celebrates International Youth Day. A state-owned company announced the offer.
items.summary_ko: 12세에서 29세 사이의 청년들은 이번 수요일에 포르투갈의 국립 박물관과 기념물을 무료로 관람할 수 있습니다. 국제 청년의 날을 기념하기 위한 이번 무료 입장은 국영 기업이 발표했습니다.
items.title_en: Free museum entry for young people in Portugal
items.title_ko: 포르투갈 청년들, 박물관 무료 관람
items.title_original: Portuguese museums and monuments with free admission for young people

items.raw_excerpt: Low levels uncover the remains of the buildings, which were once part of the village of Nether Hambleton.
items.summary_en: Drought lowered the water levels of the reservoir. The remains of the buildings from the lost village of Nether Hambleton are now uncovered. The ruins were once part of a village that disappeared long ago.
items.summary_ko: 가뭄으로 저수지 수위가 낮아졌습니다. 잊혔던 네더햄블턴 마을의 건물 유적이 다시 모습을 드러냈습니다. 이 폐허는 한때 마을에 속해 있던 곳입니다.
items.title_en: Lost village revealed as drought lowers water levels

items.raw_excerpt: There are no previous records of a baby being born on a VR service, the rail operator says.
items.summary_en: A baby was born on a train in Finland. The rail operator says there are no previous records of a baby being born on a VR service.

items.raw_excerpt: As Iceland goes dark, NASA-supported researchers will launch 80 balloons to measure how the eclipse changes the atmosphere close to the ground.
items.summary_en: As Iceland goes dark, NASA-supported researchers will launch 80 balloons into the sky. They want to measure how the eclipse changes the atmosphere close to the ground.
items.summary_ko: 아이슬란드 하늘이 어두워지는 동안 NASA가 지원하는 연구팀이 풍선 80개를 하늘로 띄웁니다. 일식이 지표면 가까운 대기를 어떻게 바꾸는지 측정하려는 것입니다.
items.title_en: NASA Teams Launch 80 Balloons During Iceland Eclipse
items.title_ko: 아이슬란드 일식, NASA 연구팀 풍선 80개 띄운다
items.title_original: NASA Teams to Launch 80 Balloons During Iceland Eclipse

items.raw_excerpt: Discover Merrickville, Ontario’s best-preserved 19th-century village along the Rideau Canal. Explore historic blockhouses, local dining, and artisan shops.
items.summary_en: Merrickville is one of Ontario's oldest and most historic villages, located along the Rideau Canal. Visitors can explore old blockhouses, local restaurants, and artisan shops. The village gives people a feeling of stepping back in time.
items.summary_ko: 메릭빌은 온타리오주에서 가장 오래되고 역사 깊은 마을 중 하나로, 라이도 운하를 따라 자리하고 있습니다. 방문객들은 옛 방어시설, 현지 식당, 수공예 상점 등을 둘러볼 수 있습니다. 이 마을은 과거로 돌아간 듯한 느낌을 선사합니다.
items.title_en: Merrickville: a preserved 19th-century village in Ontario
items.title_ko: 온타리오주에 남은 19세기 마을 메릭빌
items.title_original: Preserved 19th-century village that's among the oldest and most historic in Ontario feels like stepping back in time - Toronto.com

items.raw_excerpt: A community festival in Western Newfoundland met with an ongoing spruce budworm infestation to create an unforgettable concert experience for performers and attendees alike this August.
items.summary_en: A community festival in western Newfoundland met a spruce budworm moth outbreak this August. The moths turned a concert into an unforgettable experience for performers and the audience. The moth swarm is a sign of the region's spruce budworm problem.
items.summary_ko: 서부 뉴펀들랜드의 마을 축제가 이번 8월 가문비나무싹벌레 나방의 대발생을 만났다. 나방 떼가 덮친 콘서트는 연주자와 관객 모두에게 잊지 못할 공연이 됐다. 이는 지역의 가문비나무싹벌레 피해가 심각하다는 징후다.
items.title_en: Moths swarm a festival concert in Newfoundland
items.title_ko: 뉴펀들랜드 축제 콘서트에 나방 떼 습격
items.title_original: Moth madness at Pasadena festival symptom of spruce budworm battle in N.L.

items.raw_excerpt: The Municipality of Loulé is preparing a major programme to tackle the growing number of stray cats across the region, with around 500 animals already identified for sterilisation under a new Capture, Neuter and Return (CNR) initiative.
items.summary_en: The town of Loulé plans to sterilise about 500 stray cats. The new Capture, Neuter and Return programme aims to slow the growing number of stray cats across the region.
items.summary_ko: 룰레 시가 지역 곳곳에 늘어나는 길고양이 문제를 해결하기 위해 큰 계획을 준비하고 있다. 새 포획·중성화·방사 프로그램으로 약 500마리를 대상으로 중성화 수술을 진행할 예정이다.
items.title_en: Stray cats to be sterilised in the Algarve

items.raw_excerpt: Hamilton Mayor Andrea Horwath says she has sent letters to local businesses about an anti-immigration group that could be renting space in the city for a conference. Horwath says people are free to promote their views, but wants the community to be informed.
items.summary_en: Hamilton Mayor Andrea Horwath has sent letters to local businesses about an anti-immigration group that could rent space in the city for a conference. She says people are free to promote their views, but the community should be informed.
items.summary_ko: 해밀턴 시장 안드레아 호르와스가 반이민 성향 단체가 도시 내 공간을 빌려 컨퍼런스를 열 수도 있다는 내용의 서한을 지역 업체들에 보냈습니다. 시장은 사람들이 자신의 견해를 밝힐 자유가 있지만, 지역사회가 이에 대해 잘 알고 있어야 한다고 말했습니다.
items.title_en: Hamilton mayor asks businesses to be aware of anti-immigration group planning a conference in the area
items.title_ko: 해밀턴 시장, 반이민 단체 컨퍼런스 계획 관련 지역 업체들에 서한
items.title_original: Hamilton mayor asks businesses to be aware of anti-immigration group planning conference in area

items.raw_excerpt: If you want to have a European-style getaway without booking a flight, you don't have to travel very far this summer.
items.summary_en: This village near Montreal is a great place for a European-style getaway. You do not need a flight to reach it. It has cute shops and feels like a summer fairytale.
items.summary_ko: 몬트리올 근처의 이 마을은 비행기를 타지 않고도 유럽풍 휴가를 즐기기에 좋은 곳입니다. 귀여운 상점들이 늘어서 있어 여름 동화 같은 분위기를 느낄 수 있습니다.
items.title_en: A dreamy village near Montreal has cute shops and a summer fairytale look

items.raw_excerpt: Khi tiếng trống khai hội vừa dứt, các đô vật bắt đầu lên sới thi đấu. Tương tự luật thi đấu vật dân tộc, đô vật đánh ngã đồng thời giữ hoặc đè được đối thủ ở tư thế “lấm lưng, trắng bụng” (tức một phần hoặc cả hai phần lưng của đối phương phải lấm đất, bụng ngửa lên trời) trong vòng 3 giây thì được công nhận thắng.
items.source_name: Trung tâm Nội dung số và Truyền thông
items.summary_en: The annual wrestling festival of Sinh village has begun in Hue. Wrestlers follow folk wrestling rules. A wrestler wins by pinning an opponent's back on the ground for three seconds.

items.raw_excerpt: A call for petrol-style price signs has revived a familiar problem for EV drivers in Austria: working out what a charge will cost before plugging in.
items.summary_en: People in Austria want charging stations to show prices like petrol stations do. Drivers still find it hard to know the cost before plugging in. This article explains ways to compare charging prices.
items.summary_ko: 오스트리아에서 주유소처럼 충전소에도 요금을 표시하자는 요청이 나오면서 전기차 운전자들의 오래된 고민이 다시 주목받고 있다. 충전을 시작하기 전에 비용이 얼마인지 알기 어렵다는 문제다. 이 글은 충전 요금을 비교하는 방법을 설명한다.
items.title_en: How can drivers compare electric-car charging prices in Austria?

items.raw_excerpt: Want to publish an Icelandic book abroad? Translation grants are open through September 15, with extra support this year for children’s and YA titles.
items.summary_en: Iceland is offering translation grants to foreign publishers who want to bring Icelandic books to new readers. Applications are open through September 15. This year, children's and young adult books get extra support.

items.summary_en: A fair sponsor is giving away the last eclipse glasses for the total eclipse. People who missed the sold-out supermarkets and pharmacies can still get a pair today.
